Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Introducing Instagram Teen Accounts: Built-In Protections for Teens, Peace of Mind for Parents.

Decision cutoff: 2024-09-17T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Introducing Instagram Teen Accounts: Built-In Protections for Teens, Peace of Mind for Parents. Published date: 2024-09-17. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2024/09/instagram-teen-accounts.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Update on June 11, 2025 at 1:30PM PT: To build on this success, we’ve added new built-in restrictions for Instagram Teen Accounts, so that teens under 16 can’t access Live without a parent’s permission, or turn off the protection that hides unwanted images in DMs . Today, we’re introducing Instagram Teen Accounts, a new experience for teens, guided by parents. We’ll automatically place teens into Teen Accounts, and teens under 16 will need a parent’s permission to change any of these settings to be less strict. “Given that parents today are grappling with the benefits and challenges of the internet and digital media for their teens, our association applauds Meta for launching Instagram Teen Accounts.
